name: sol-perp-short
rationale: A9 example: a 3x SOL short on Jupiter Perps that fades a spike. Entry when SOL is 1.5% over its 60-bar low and RSI(14) is over 65; out on a 1.5% take-profit (the price falling), a 2% stop (the price rising, well inside the 16.55% limit at 3x) or after 4 hours. 10 USD of collateral (30 USD of exposure) a time inside a 30 USD budget. Not tuned: it shows the perp backtest, not an edge.
